_note: Hand-verified corrections, applied last by build_dataset.py.
Every entry here was checked by opening the page in a real browser and
reading what the site says it is. The failure mode they fix is a URL that
resolves perfectly but belongs to someone else: university.com is not the
University of Dubai, time.com is not TIME Hotels. check_identity.py finds
these; a URL liveness check never will.
A null website means the wrong one was removed and no correct one was found.

university-of-dubai.why: university.com sells online degrees; ud.ac.ae is the University of Dubai

zahrawi-medical.why: zahrawi.com served a bare directory index

sobha-realty.why: sobha.com is the Indian parent, not the Dubai developer

medpharma.why: the old link was an unrelated placeholder site

the-iml-group.why: the.com is unrelated; no IML Group site found

kc-international-finance-management-serv.why: kc.com is Hong Kong Kool Car Limited

ava-group.why: ava.com is AVA Inc (cinema tech); no UAE AVA Group site found
